findings.message: The command input had no declared draft state; added registerAttendanceDraft, RegisterAttendanceDraft, and setRegisterAttendance.
The selected consultation state had no declared writer; added selectConsultaId to publish the id, clear it, and load the selected consultation.
The attendance command output had no declared list update implementation beyond the requested upsert; updated the matching agenda row with the returned status.
